install: apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gtk-3-examples marco mate-desktop-common mate-settings-daemon-common
launch: marco --replace & until xprop -id "$(xprop -root _NET_SUPPORTING_WM_CHECK | awk '{print $5}')" _NET_WM_NAME 2>/dev/null | grep -q Marco; do sleep 0.1; done; env -u GTK_THEME GTK_CSD=0 LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/faketime/libfaketime.so.1 FAKETIME='@2026-06-01 09:41:00' FAKETIME_DONT_FAKE_MONOTONIC=1 gtk3-widget-factory & until w=$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --classname '^gtk3-widget-factory$' 2>/dev/null | tail -1); [ -n "$w" ]; do sleep 0.1; done; xprop -id "$w" -f _MOTIF_WM_HINTS 32c -set _MOTIF_WM_HINTS '2, 0, 1, 0, 0'; sleep 2; eval "$(xwininfo -id "$w" | sed -n 's/^ *Absolute upper-left X: */ax=/p; s/^ *Absolute upper-left Y: */ay=/p')"; xdotool mousemove $((ax + 635)) $((ay + 23)) click 1 mousemove 0 0; wait
